name: Knowledge and understanding
description: Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of economic definitions, formulas, concepts and theories; Use economic terminology.

name: Analysis
description: Select, organise and interpret economics data and information; Apply economic analysis to written, numerical, diagrammatic and graphical data; Analyse economic issues, identifying and developing links and relationships.

name: Evaluation
description: Evaluate economic information, data and arguments, and recognise that economic decisions have uncertain outcomes.
